items.statement: Published and grey reports of technician-led discharge reconciliation will describe a small number of supervision models, most requiring pharmacist review of flagged discrepancies, with no consistent patient outcome.
items.rationale: Directly informs the committee's decision on how, not only whether, to extend the role.
items.risks: Grey reports may be hard to find within four hours a week.

items.statement: Regulatory scope, not evidence of accuracy, will be the main limit on technicians' discharge role in most jurisdictions.
items.rationale: Scope varied widely while accuracy data were consistent (claims c1, c3).

items.statement: Reports from rural hospitals will describe remote pharmacist supervision more often than urban reports.
items.rationale: Distance to supervising pharmacists is a stated rural barrier.

summary: Three mapping expectations; h1 selected as the organising expectation for charting.
